title: Rental Charge Rule for the CondoGuard Unit Rental Endorsement
content:
**Rule 1. Where the endorsement is written.** A unit rental endorsement is recorded on a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy only where the tier allows a unit rented to others, and it changes the occupancy on the declarations to rented to others.

**Rule 2. Full-year rental charge.** The full-year rental charge is the tier's unit rental annual premium plus the landlord liability load, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Rule 3. Landlord liability load.** The landlord liability load is the tier's annual premium per liability step when the declarations carry the higher of the tier's two personal liability limits, and nothing when they carry the lower one.

**Rule 4. Charge for the rest of the term.** The rental charge for the rest of the term is the full-year rental charge multiplied by the calendar days from the day the endorsement takes effect to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term (the calendar days from the term's effective date to its expiration date), rounded half-up to the cent. The full-year figure is rounded first and the day fraction is applied to the rounded figure. Each rounding of the rental charge to the cent is half-up in exact decimal: a figure lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the higher cent.

| Personal liability limit on the declarations | Landlord liability load |
|---|---|
| the higher of the tier's two limits | the tier's annual premium per liability step |
| the lower of the tier's two limits | nothing |

## Worked rating (hypothetical figures)

Tier unit rental annual premium 86.00 USD, tier annual premium per liability step 14.00 USD, declarations at the higher of the tier's two limits, 146 days left in a 365-day term.

1. Landlord liability load: 14.00 USD.
2. Full-year rental charge: 86.00 plus 14.00, 100.00 USD.
3. Charge for the rest of the term: 100.00 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365, 40.00 USD.

On a tier with a unit rental annual premium of 64.00 USD and a step premium of 18.00 USD, at the higher limit with 100 days left in a 365-day term, the full-year rental charge is 82.00 USD and the charge for the rest of the term is 82.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 365, 22.4657..., which rounds to 22.47 USD.
